CEASEFIRE

Tap a unit to select it, drag to box-select, tap the map to move, tap an enemy to attack. Two fingers pan and zoom.

Battlefield controls

  • Tap or click a unit to select it. Tap the ground to move, or an enemy to attack. Select army chooses your combat troops.
  • Pan lets you drag the map with one finger or mouse. Select lets you drag a box around units. Two fingers always pan and pinch to zoom.
  • + / − zoom, ◎ returns to your base, and Fit shows the whole map. Tap the radar to move the camera.
  • Build / Train / Orders / Diplomacy open the command panel. In phone landscape, tap Commands to open the drawer. Tap Hide, Commands again, or the map to close it. On a narrow upright screen, tap the active tab again or Hide. Stats shows the battle meters.
  • Mouse and keyboard: right-click to order; middle-drag to pan; wheel to zoom. Focus the map and use arrow keys or WASD to pan. Space pauses, Escape cancels, and 1–4 set speed.

Sound should start when you deploy. If it stops after switching apps, tap Tap for sound. If Sound on stays silent, restart it here and listen for two notes.

Tzeva Adom

צבע אדום · Seven Fronts

The battle for survival

Two blocs, real alliances. Israel and the US hold the line while Hezbollah rockets the north, Hamas tunnels in from Gaza and Iran races for a bomb. Washington and Tehran pull the strings: sanctions, Hormuz, the Houthi blockade, Gulf capitals and gas prices all shape the war. Rockets are cheap, interceptors are not.

Campaign

Red Alert-style missions that follow the real war, from October 7, 2023 onward. Each level has its own map, briefing and objectives.

War map (strategic mode)

Fight front by front on a theatre map. Resolve, regime stability, relations and 3 ceasefires carry over between battles.

Skirmish

Opponent
  • Select: tap a unit, or drag a box around several. Double-tap selects all of that type.
  • Command: tap ground to move (units fire on the way), tap a visible enemy to attack.
  • Map: pinch or scroll to zoom, two fingers or right-drag to pan. V or the 2.5D button switches between the isometric view and classic top-down. Keys 1–4 set the game speed.
  • Diplomacy: 3 ceasefires per bloc. Your patron proposes, the other patron must consent.
  • Allies: each bloc shares vision. Your allies are run by the AI.
  • The bomb: if Iran’s nuclear breakout reaches 100%, the Axis wins. Strike its enrichment site; B-2s need no Gulf bases.
  • Economy: high oil and gas prices and Gulf pressure erode US Resolve, less so as Iran nears a bomb. Israel’s resolve is about survival, not prices.
